Welcome to Ask Dr. Steve DVM® YouTube channel, where the world of veterinary care comes together! Dr. Steve Marsden is a license veterinarian in California and Canada.  He is an accomplished integrative veterinarian, seamlessly blending the worlds of conventional and holistic veterinary medicine. He's on a mission to share FREE veterinary education.

On his 'Ask Dr. Steve DVM®' Facebook page, where he provides free advice, he's been a trusted source of guidance for pet owners. Our goal is simple yet profound: to empower pet owners with the knowledge they need to give their beloved pets the best life possible.

Join us for informative and engaging content, from pet care tips and insights into holistic wellness to expert advice on common pet health issues like allergies, anxiety, cancer, hip dysplasia, ear infections, diet, disc disease, kidney and liver disease, and gut health.

Subscribe today and embark on a journey of love, care, and learning, all dedicated to your beloved pets.
